dim-50 gauss_sieve db 4259 vectors against the recipe's 4075 and BATCH-f75059's 4166. The recipe pins no seed for this check; I pinned FPLLL.set_random_seed(20260803), which the recipe's own run did not.

Scores use the cosine addition formula rather than BATCH-f75059's modular route, so every null arm shares one set of transcendentals and is paired by construction. Verified identical at 3.1e-14 (Stage A) and 2.0e-15 (Stage B).
Stage A uses 2000 error draws per arm (BATCH-f75059's replicates used 500) and 10 row-permutation realisations (RT-20260803-dc7568 used 5). Both exceed the card's >=1000 requirement.

In the decay control the row permutation is applied WITHIN the subsample of size N', so the surrogate's y-multiset matches the subsample's own. RT-20260803-dc7568's script is scratch and unarchived, so whether it did the same is unknown.

The first-choice sensitivity demonstration (SENS-2c, pairing by matched length rank) FAILED to move the statistic at smoke scale and was replaced by the rearrangement construction and the dose-response BEFORE the official run. SENS-2c is retained and reported. No official run was repeated.
Stage B ran 3 instances, not 9; its across-instance sd carries 2 degrees of freedom.

Stage B's group-level null carries NO sufficient sensitivity demonstration (SENS-1 barely moves the statistic; SENS-3 is non-monotone on 0 of 3 instances at every p) and is therefore declared inadmissible for a blindness conclusion rather than reported as a negative observation.

SENS-0 stated and verified as a theorem: the correct-secret score is BITWISE invariant under any row permutation of Y (max|delta| = 0.0 exactly). This is batch 2's NULL-V defect proved rather than argued.

SENS-2, an ANALYTIC rearrangement-inequality bound on the expected score over the class of all N! pairings, using the EXACT discrete characteristic function rather than the continuous-Gaussian idealisation. Predicted and measured differences agree to <= 3.8e-05.
SENS-3 dose-response with a monotonicity prediction pre-declared in the script header before the run.
Stage B's B3 measurement (sieve, certificate, FFT-bin scoring, nulls) beyond the card's required design record. Adjacent FFT bins give near-misses their principled definition.

The secret_distribution group separates too, 9 of 9 instances, excess 1.0254 +/- 0.0113 and 1.0238 +/- 0.0022. Not in batch 2's table. Magnitude an order of magnitude below near_miss, and the correct-minus-best effect has the OPPOSITE sign.

The near-miss excess is monotone increasing in N'; at N' <= 2000 it is 1.01-1.04 and would not have been detected. RT-20260803-dc7568's 'invisible at N' <= 2000' caveat is confirmed on nine instances.

Under the principled adjacent-FFT-bin near-miss definition the raw sd ratio is about 1.0, not batch 2's about 0.14. The 6.7x concentration batches 1-2 measured is a property of the ad-hoc s + e_k definition, whose phase offset -Y[.,k] is small.
Stage B's modeled Nf spans 99.3 (p=5) to 45129 (p=2), a 454x range driven almost entirely by the adjacent-bin term. MODELED.
No script failed during an official run. Five smoke runs, all recorded, all writing only to scratch.
